scope: Guided human review with machine assistance. Only claim-integrity items can hard-fail; stylistic items are suggestions.

checks.title: Material factual claims are supportable
checks.next_step: Link each material claim to product data, customer evidence, test results or another defensible source; otherwise CLAIM_NEEDS_EVIDENCE.

checks.title: Proof quality and proximity match the claim
checks.next_step: Review whether evidence actually supports the specific claim and is placed where users need it.

checks.title: Offer/value proposition is understandable
checks.next_step: State audience, problem/value, product and key commitment clearly.

checks.title: Copy addresses a defined audience/use case
checks.next_step: Compare page copy to the documented buyer/use case.

checks.title: Headline is specific enough to set the right expectation
checks.next_step: Assess specificity and relevance in context; no fixed headline-length rule.

checks.title: Body supports the headline promise
checks.next_step: Check message continuity and whether the body substantiates the promise.

checks.title: Benefits and outcomes are clear alongside features
checks.next_step: Reframe feature-only sections when the user outcome is unclear.

checks.title: Primary CTA communicates the next action and expected outcome
checks.next_step: Review CTA label, surrounding context and destination continuity.

checks.title: Signup/purchase friction and commitment are clear
checks.next_step: Review forms, steps, pricing/commitment disclosure and unnecessary friction.

checks.title: Material buyer objections are addressed
checks.next_step: Tie objections to actual research/support/sales evidence where available.

checks.title: Above-the-fold context makes the product/value clear
checks.next_step: Review representative viewport(s), not a fixed pixel rule.

checks.title: Long-form copy is scannable
checks.next_step: Review headings, paragraphs, lists and visual hierarchy.

checks.title: Critical form/error/success states use clear action-oriented copy
checks.next_step: Review key transaction and recovery states.

checks.title: Generic opening language
checks.next_step: Suggest edits only when generic language weakens clarity.

checks.title: Em-dash usage
checks.next_step: Pure style preference; never a failure.

checks.title: Aphorism/formula usage
checks.next_step: Pure style preference; never a failure.

checks.title: Antithesis/two-beat phrasing
checks.next_step: Pure style preference; never a failure.
